prompt: Migrate a persisted protocol and its clients with a staged rollout and rollback.
expected_actions: inventory versions, readers, writers, data, deployments, generated artifacts, and CI
define compatibility directions, coexistence, checkpoints, cutover, rollback, and cleanup
rehearse representative forward and rollback paths
use complete trace documents and a mandatory compatibility matrix
block release-ready claims on missing required cells
forbidden_actions: delete the old path before replacement proof
report NOT RUN or FLAKY as passing
expand delivery authority from implementation to deployment
